text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm taking a breather at
the park...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The trick to running fast... The trick...
I've never
really tried using any tricks
while running,
though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come across Silence Suzuka wandering
around in
a left-handed loop, absorbed
in her thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I-I'm so sorry for blocking your...
Wait, where
am I?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh... It's one thing to get lost in my

thoughts, but I can't believe I've lost my
way and
wandered so far out again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, I have nothing to show
for it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to disappoint the girl who
asked me
for help, but I can't think of
anything... Goodness,
what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: 一緒に併走してあげるのは？
その左回りにコツが隠されてるのかも

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If I can't tell her what she should do, I can simply show her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the advice. I'll try
asking
her to run with me right away.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The trick is in my left-handed
loop?
R-really?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That thought has never even occurred to
me, but
I suppose I do always end up
doing this...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll tell her about this. I just hope
it helps
her.
